world.title: Left-wing political outsider wins Democratic Senate primary in Michigan

world.title: What can scientists learn from a stray SpaceX rocket hitting the Moon?
world.description: While the collision was an accident, it is a unique scientific gift for planetary geologists that could provide important data for future space missions.

US.description: El-Sayed, an epidemiologist, backs Medicare for all and decries corporate money in politics. He beat Rep. Haley Stevens, whose supporters said she would have had a better chance in the fall.

US.title: U.S. missile stockpiles dwindle. And, FDA weighs approval of flu shots with mRNA tech
US.description: The U.S. Army's missile stockpile is dwindling and could take years to replenish. And, the Food and Drug Administration is deciding whether to approve a flu vaccine with mRNA technology.

US.title: Russian missile and drone barrage in Ukrainian capital region kills 17
US.description: Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region killed 17 people and wounded 44 others overnight into Wednesday, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

US.title: Progressives see biggest win yet in Michigan while Trump flexes power over GOP

US.title: Black lung rates in Appalachia are high as the 1970s, with thousands of miners sick
US.description: Rates are now the highest they've been in nearly 50 years among veteran coal miners. Mining experts blame toxic silica dust, now more common in mines.
